label: F40 Cloudreach old_wind_observatory High|Medium
brief: Fixed production-camera views of one Cloudreach location (old wind observatory) across times of day and weather, with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the key art's Cloudreach sky realm: a coherent place of layered floating land, readable landmarks and light that belongs to the world.
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground

Clipping (geometry passing through geometry, or the camera inside geometry)
